title: GEMglStencilOp
description: set front and back stencil test actions

messages.description: action when the stencil test fails, e.g. GL_KEEP
action when the stencil test passes but the depth test fails
action when both the stencil and the depth test pass

arguments.description: action when the stencil test fails, e.g. GL_KEEP
action when the stencil test passes but the depth test fails
action when both the stencil and the depth test pass

body: [GEMglStencilOp] calls glStencilOp() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. Its creation arguments also take GL constants by name; its inlets only take their values. See glStencilOp in the OpenGL reference.
